import solution


def test_issue_example_no_duplicates():
    """Example from issue: [1,2,3,4,5] with all distinct elements returns False."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([1, 2, 3, 4, 5])
    expected = False  # distinct=4+1=5, total=5, 5-5=0 duplicates -> False
    assert result is expected


def test_issue_empty_array():
    """Empty array contains no duplicate element so returns False."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([])
    expected = False  # total=0+0=0, distinct=0, 0-0=0 duplicates -> False
    assert result is expected


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Single-element array contains no duplicate element so returns False."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([42])
    expected = False  # total=1, distinct=1, 1-1=0 duplicates -> False
    assert result is expected


def test_issue_two_equal_elements():
    """Two equal elements mean the array contains a duplicate so returns True."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([7, 7])
    expected = True  # count(7)=1+1=2, 2>1 -> True
    assert result is expected


def test_issue_two_different_elements():
    """Two different elements mean no duplicate so returns False."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([7, 8])
    expected = False  # total=2, distinct=1+1=2, 2-2=0 duplicates -> False
    assert result is expected


def test_issue_duplicate_first_and_last():
    """Duplicate at first and last positions means a duplicate exists so returns True."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([1, 2, 3, 4, 1])
    expected = True  # count(1)=1+1=2, 2>1 -> True
    assert result is expected


def test_issue_all_elements_same():
    """Array where every element is the same contains a duplicate so returns True."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([9, 9, 9, 9])
    expected = True  # count(9)=3+1=4, 4>1 -> True
    assert result is expected


def test_issue_adjacent_duplicate():
    """Adjacent equal elements mean a duplicate exists so returns True."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([1, 2, 2, 3, 4])
    expected = True  # count(2)=1+1=2, 2>1 -> True
    assert result is expected


def test_issue_negative_numbers_duplicate():
    """Duplicate negative integers mean a duplicate exists so returns True."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([-3, -1, -2, -3])
    expected = True  # count(-3)=1+1=2, 2>1 -> True
    assert result is expected


def test_issue_zero_duplicate():
    """Duplicate zero means a duplicate exists so returns True."""
    result = solution.test_duplicate([0, 1, 2, 3, 0])
    expected = True  # count(0)=1+1=2, 2>1 -> True
    assert result is expected


def test_contract_exact_bool_when_no_duplicate():
    """Contract: result must be exactly bool type when no duplicate exists."""
    expected = False  # total=2+1=3 distinct, 3-3=0 duplicates -> False
    result = solution.test_duplicate([1, 2, 3])
    assert type(result) is type(expected)


def test_contract_exact_bool_when_duplicate():
    """Contract: result must be exactly bool type when a duplicate exists."""
    expected = True  # count(5)=1+1=2, 2>1 -> True
    result = solution.test_duplicate([5, 6, 5])
    assert type(result) is type(expected)
